items.source: Creates a CompositeReactiveHealthContributorConfiguration that will use the given indicatorFactory to create ReactiveHealthIndicator instances.
items.translation: 创建一个 CompositeReactiveHealthContributorConfiguration`，它将使用给定的 indicatorFactory` 来创建 ReactiveHealthIndicator 实例。

items.source: Creates a composite contributor from the beans of the given beanType retrieved from the given beanFactory.
items.translation: 从给定的 beanFactory` 中检索给定 beanType` 的 bean，并创建一个组合贡献者。

items.source:
Base class for health contributor configurations that can combine source beans into a
composite.
items.translation: 可作为健康贡献者配置的基础类，能够将源 Bean 组合为复合 Bean。

items.source: indicatorFactory - the function to create health indicator instances
items.translation: indicatorFactory - 用于创建健康指标实例的函数

items.source: beanFactory - the bean factory from which the beans are retrieved
items.translation: beanFactory - 从中获取 Bean 的 Bean 工厂

items.source: beanType - the type of the beans that are retrieved
items.translation: beanType - 检索到的 Bean 的类型
